normalization: divide by median valid reference flux
important_limitations: The output is a reference-spectrum candidate, not ground truth.
The large gap in the 5077 observation is preserved rather than filled.
Lower-resolution and photometric observations are not merged into the high-resolution reference.
Flux uncertainties are derived from the absolute FLAMERR1/FLAMERR2 values.
No atmospheric molecules are inferred by this preprocessing step.
